purpose: Teach: 宅急便/鼻水/一戸建て/仮眠/鉄板/年越し/着地/日向

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、宅急便、絶対、で、絶対、お菓子、絶対、送ってもらったわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm telling you — Mei-sis really did get sweets delivered by courier.
lines.style: Warm, animated delight. Opening with Sho's name draws him in. Gentle emphasis on the earnestness of the moment. Speech rises slightly at the middle. Affectionate at the tail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、鼻水、絶対、ぐずついてるんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I'm not gonna lie, my nose is kind of running a little.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact delivery. No shame, just stating a small fact about his body. Slight pause before the admission. Genuine six-year-old honesty without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、いつか、絶対、一戸建て、絶対、お庭付きの、絶対、家、絶対、住みたいわ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho — someday I really do want to live in a house with a garden of my own.
lines.style: Slower, thoughtful rhythm. Gaze drifting inward. Warmth still there, but now it's tinged with longing. Opens up her future to him. Ends gently with his name.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お昼に、絶対、仮眠、絶対、しちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, honestly — I totally fell asleep at lunchtime.
lines.style: Self-aware, slightly sheepish admission. A small smile in the voice. Light delivery, like he's confessing something mildly funny about himself. Not defensive, just observing his own silliness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、鉄板、絶対、お料理、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、教わったわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother really did teach me how to cook on that iron griddle — I learned so much.
lines.style: Soft, appreciative tone. A memory warming her voice from the inside. Gratitude woven through each phrase. Slight breathiness on the teaching part, like she's still learning. Gentle and sincere.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、年越し、絶対、ぼくたちのお家、絶対、来てよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — come spend New Year's Eve with us. Please come.
lines.style: Earnest, pulling her in. Direct eye contact in the voice. Hope underneath, but not desperate — he's stating what he wants simply. Small pause before the final appeal.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 体操選手の、本気で、絶対、着地、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、いつも、絶対、ハラハラするわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, when gymnasts land — honestly, it always makes my heart catch.
lines.style: Reflective, a touch worried. Soft intake of breath on the landing moment. Rhythm slows as she describes the tension. Affectionate exasperation — a very Mei thing. Closes with his name, drawing him into her vulnerability.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、公園の、絶対、日向、絶対、ぼくと、絶対、一緒に、絶対、お弁当、絶対、食べようよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — let's eat lunch together in the sunny part of the park, okay?
lines.style: Warm invitation, gently insistent. Small, certain voice. Simple desire laid out plainly. Rising lift at the end, asking but not really asking — this is something he wants and he's inviting her into it. Close, earnest.
